The navigational marker appears on the HUD and points directly to the selected objective (like a quest), a selected icon on the world map, or the selected Map Pin. While facing in the direction of the marker, it'll display the distance in yards. Markers pointing to game-provided objectives will point to the exact location of that objective, while markers generated from clicking on map pins will always be at the same height as the player.

Neighborhoods are shared residential zones composed of approximately fifty player Housing plots, where player characters can reside either alongside randomly assigned neighbors or chosen companions. These instanced environments are persistent, meaning neighbors remain the same unless someone relocates. It was announced alongside Housing at Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct. Neighborhoods come in two forms: * Public Neighborhoods, created and maintained automatically by the game servers as needed. * Private Neighborhoods, created and owned by players, either by guilds as Guild Neighborhoods, or by arbitrary groups of players as Charter Neighborhoods. A Nether-Warped Egg can rarely be fished up in the Voidstorm. It can also drop from Patient Treasures, which sometimes appear when fishing in any zone. After seven days, it will hatch into the Nether-Swept Drake mount.

Neutral is a categorization given to the unplayable NPC faction in the game. These units are the various bosses that make up the game, alongside several uncollectible minis that make up their encounters. Each mission has unique boss mechanics that require the player to come up with strategies to overcome their enemies.
Neural Silencer Mk3 is created with Dragon Isles Engineering (15); taught by Schematic: Neural Silencer Mk3.
Neverending Soul Vessel is a resusable item that allows warlocks to cast their next spell without using Soul Shards.
